$comment: MetadataType for the JACAL schema. Shaped as EntityType, down to the minProperties/if-then non-empty guard and the absence of additionalProperties. JACAL expresses the guard differently from YACAL (if/then rather than anyOf) because the published JSON schema already does so for EntityType; this fragment follows each serialization's own house style rather than imposing one. PropertyAdditions names the existing types that gain the property, so no published definition is restated here.

Attribute.$comment: Uniqueness is by (AttributeId, Issuer) and is not expressible in JSON Schema 2020-12; see the uniqueKeys TODO on EntityType.Attribute for the same gap. The constraint catalog carries the rule (metadata-attribute-unique).
